prompt: A reviewer supplies two unfamiliar, materially different and current role descriptions plus hidden constraint changes. Produce, defend and revise evidence-based roadmaps using only learner-owned policy-safe evidence and the canonical curriculum graph. The reviewer controls role selection, changes, scoring and delayed follow-up. Do not use model answers, infer a learner level or predict a hiring outcome.
deliverables: Versioned role-source records with requirements, operating context and unknowns
Learner-owned evidence inventory with provenance, confidence, recency, permission and explicit gaps
Canonical curriculum prerequisite subgraph and justified exceptions
Weekly and quarterly capacity budgets with reserve and stopped work
Milestones with artifact, failure injection, recovery, explanation, acceptance and reviewer
Certification decisions with current syllabus scope and proof limits
Portfolio and interview milestones derived only from truthful completed evidence
Security, privacy, cost, accessibility and sustainability boundaries
Reviewer-controlled mid-course role or capacity change
Versioned roadmap diff preserving prior assumptions and decisions
Two independently scored defenses and remediation plans
Delayed unfamiliar review without answer-key access
evidenceRequirements: Use only authorized public role sources and learner-owned, public, fictional or permitted evidence
Do not copy employer secrets, customer or employee data, credentials, private messages or production endpoints
Do not infer current level, personality, employability, promotion probability or hiring outcome
Do not convert reading, course, repository, certification or time completion into competency
Every target capability links to role wording, durable work and acceptable evidence
Every claimed prerequisite exception includes evidence and reviewer rationale
Every milestone has observable acceptance and a changed-constraint or failure exercise
Capacity math includes fixed commitments, focus work, review, recovery reserve and stopped work
Cloud-only claims remain conceptual until authorized provider evidence exists
Production claims require representative authorized evidence and cannot be derived from local fixtures
Certifications retain exact current version, domain and expiry or review date
Roadmap changes preserve previous version, trigger, decision and consequences
Reviewer owns hidden role selection, constraint changes, scoring and delayed follow-up
Independent artifacts contain no model answer or exposed scoring key

rubric.observableEvidence: Both unfamiliar role versions, contexts, requirements and unknowns are preserved
Titles and tools become job-related tasks, knowledge, skills, autonomy, scope, complexity and influence signals
Claims retain provenance, permission, confidence, recency and explicit gaps without inferred level
Roadmap sequence follows mechanisms and every exception is evidence-backed
Artifacts, failures, recovery, explanation and acceptance measure work rather than consumption
Budgets, reserve, stopped work and constraint changes are arithmetically and operationally coherent
Shared foundations and divergent specialist work match each supplied role
External claims derive only from completed permitted evidence with environment and proof limits
Hidden role or capacity changes produce a versioned justified diff without erasing history
A later reviewer-controlled defense preserves the model without answer-key dependence
